remarks: A rare treat! Conveniently located on the post road very close to exit 13 and the Darien line. This apartment feels much bigger than it is due to the vaulted ceilings. The spacious kitchen with plenty of room for a table opens to the great room with windows facing east and south. 2 skylights bring even more sunlight to the delightful, oversized space. This room is versatile and could allow for a dining room/living room combo and even a at home office set up! The bedroom has a large closet and speaking of storage, one of the two entrances has plenty of room for those extra items we all have. Michael's cleaners is on the first floor, so have them wash and fold your laundry for you! This won't last so hurry on down!
